title: Preventing Patient Data Boundary Violations in AI-Generated Code
description: AI coding agents can wire patient records into analytics code that passes every test. How to turn patient data boundaries into checks that block the change.
og_headline: Keep patient data inside its boundary
og_alt: Mneme HQ editorial card: Keep patient data inside its boundary. Preventing patient data boundary violations in AI-generated code.

reciprocal.desc: How to write a patient data boundary as a check an AI coding agent cannot cross unnoticed.
A worked example for healthcare code: patient data boundaries checked at the agent's edit and again before the merge.
An architectural guardrail applied to patient data, with the cases an exact-text rule misses.
